subject: MAP milestone synchronization: assessment materials, ingest checkpoints, and usage constraints
messages:
From: Alice Murray <alice.murray@quantify.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — sample delivery and constraints

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the throughput and cost controls you showed look promising for our user-facing summarization pipeline. As discussed, Quantify would like to move forward with a narrow mutual action plan to ingest a small assessment corpus and run a two-week evaluation with the following constraints: 1) up to 25k tokens of prompt/testcases/day, 2) samples limited to non-PII product reviews, and 3) no retention beyond 30 days in any sandbox environment.

I attached a short CSV with the ~150 sample testcases we talked about (testcases_sample_list.csv) and a first-draft MAP PDF (quantify_eval_map_v3.pdf). Could your team confirm the ingest checkpoint process and whether we should ship the samples via S3 presigned URL or share a Drive folder? Also looping in our legal team (legal@quantify.ai) to start on a lightweight usage addendum.

High level asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a per-token logging artifact per day (anonymized) for acceptance?
- Are we able to pin a model variant for the two-week window and define an automatic rollback to a baseline if regression is detected?

Proposed kickoff: Monday 2027-04-04 for a short 30-minute sync to lock milestones.

Best,
Alice Murray
Director of ML Ops
Quantify.ai

Attachments: testcases_sample_list.csv (CSV, 150 rows), quantify_eval_map_v3.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Murray <alice.murray@quantify.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP milestone synchronization: assessment materials, ingest checkpoints, and usage constraints

Alice — thanks for the file and the clear asks. Karthik & Neha are on the thread to confirm technical and compliance bits. Quick answers up front: we can accept S3 presigned upload (preferred) or Drive share; for audits we can emit a daily anonymized token usage report and a per-request latency/cost CSV. Pinning a model variant for the two-week run is supported — we recommend an immutable tag (e.g., redwood/gpt-serve:v202704) and we will configure a canary rollback policy tied to your regression criteria.

Suggested MAP milestones (draft):
1) 2027-04-04: Kickoff call (30m) — finalize ingestion method, acceptance criteria, legal contacts
2) 2027-04-06: Sample ingest + initial run (nuts-and-bolts, dev sandbox) — Redwood to provide ingest checklist and presigned URL
3) 2027-04-08: First acceptance snapshot (20 sample outputs, qualitative pass)
4) 2027-04-15: Full two-week canary window begins; daily anonymized reports provided
5) 2027-04-19: Final acceptance review and acceptance sign-off (or rollback)

Usage constraints to include in the addendum: no production-serving of samples, dataset retention <=30 days, redaction of any fields flagged by Quantify as sensitive, and a limit of 25k prompt tokens/day during the window. We will also enable request-scoped ephemeral logs that are purged at 30 days to match your retention requirement.

Two quick asks for your legal team so we can draft the addendum:
- Point of contact for signing
- Any mandatory contract language about audit access or encryption-at-rest KMS requirements

Karthik, can you confirm the ingest checklist + an ETA for the presigned URL? Neha, please flag anything on retention or audit that needs a different cadence.

—Marissa
Sr. TPM, Redwood Inference

Attachment references: quantify_eval_map_v3.pdf, testcases_sample_list.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Alice Murray <alice.murray@quantify.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-30T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP milestone synchronization: assessment materials, ingest checkpoints, and usage constraints

On Mon, Mar 29, 2027 at 10:03 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Suggested MAP milestones (draft):
> 1) 2027-04-04: Kickoff call (30m) — finalize ingestion method, acceptance criteria, legal contacts
> 2) 2027-04-06: Sample ingest + initial run (nuts-and-bolts, dev sandbox) — Redwood to provide ingest checklist and presigned URL

Thanks — confirming the ingest flow and technical constraints from infra: we will create a temporary S3 bucket with lifecycle rules (auto-delete after 7 days) and provide a presigned PUT URL per-bundle. Ingest checklist (high level):
- Bundle size limit: 500MB compressed
- Accepted formats: CSV or JSONL; please ensure each testcase has a stable id column
- No encrypted archives (we need to validate content during ingest)
- Manifest file required (manifest.jsonl) listing each file and classification tag (public/review/redact)

For your acceptance automation, we can produce a daily artifact: daily_usage_<date>.csv with fields {date, total_prompt_tokens, total_output_tokens, avg_latency_ms}. These will be stored to the Drive folder in read-only mode for the Quantify team.

Security note for Legal: we support customer-managed KMS keys in Private deployments; for hosted evaluation we will use Redwood-managed KMS but can encrypt object keys using a customer-provided wrapping key if required.

ETA: I will share the presigned URL and a short ingest checklist doc by 2027-04-01 EOD PT.

—Karthik
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Murray <alice.murray@quantify.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@quantify.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP milestone synchronization: assessment materials, ingest checkpoints, and usage constraints

Marissa/Karthik — thanks for the clear plan and the checklist. Legal is comfortable starting with a short addendum that mirrors the retention and non-production clauses you outlined; they asked me to include a single POC for signing: Megan Park (megan.park@quantify.ai). We reviewed the manifest requirement and will add classification tags in the CSV and provide a small sample manifest.jsonl.

We accept the proposed kickoff on 2027-04-04 at 09:00 PT — please send the calendar invite. Also, I confirm Quantify prefers the S3 presigned ingest; we will upload the bundle on 2027-04-06 morning.

One last item: can Redwood provide a short snippet or template for the acceptance criteria check (the 20-sample qualitative pass) so our evaluation engineers know what to expect? If you can paste a checklist in the kickoff doc that would be great.

Looking forward to the sync.

Best,
Alice
Director of ML Ops, Quantify.ai
